name: webgpu-audio-bridge
description: Schema-driven control-rate-to-audio-rate bridge for the browser. Turbo mode (SAB + Atomics, sub-microsecond push/pull) is shipped today; Standard mode (MessageChannel + transferable ArrayBuffer, 5-50ms latency floor) is reserved for 0.8.0 and shares the same schema DSL and frame API. Streams structured frames from a Web Worker (typically WebGPU compute) into an AudioWorklet.
